rule.name: SpringNoPostConstructIo
rule.message: Move startup work that calls a database or a remote service out of @PostConstruct, afterPropertiesSet or a @Bean initMethod (and the private helpers only they call) into an ApplicationRunner or an @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent). These run before the context is ready: there is no transaction around this call, other beans may not be proxied yet, and a failure stops the application from starting.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[ let $body := parent::ClassBody, $starts := ($body/MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.annotation.PostConstruct')]], $body[parent::ClassDeclaration[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean')]] /MethodDeclaration[@Name = 'afterPropertiesSet'][@Arity = 0], $body/MethodDeclaration[@Arity = 0][@Name = //Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')] /AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'initMethod']//StringLiteral/@ConstValue]), $onlyFrom := function($method, $callers) { let $uses := $body//(MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]] | MethodReference[*[1][self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]])[@MethodName = $method/@Name] return $method/@Visibility = 'private' and exists($uses) and (every $use in $uses satisfies exists($use/ancestor::* intersect $callers)) }, $helpers := $body/MethodDeclaration[$onlyFrom(., $starts)], $startup := ($starts, $helpers, $body/MethodDeclaration[$onlyFrom(., ($starts, $helpers))]) return exists(. intersect $startup)] //MethodCall[*[1][ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository') or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EntityManager') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EntityManager')) or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jdbc.core.simple.JdbcClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.client.RestOperations') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.client.RestClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.http.HttpClient')]]
